title: False Reports to Law Enforcement
grade_or_penalty: False report of a crime: 4th degree (3rd degree when it involves a false report of certain crimes against an officer). Fictitious report of an incident: disorderly persons
key_points: Knowingly giving false information to law enforcement with purpose to implicate another, or reporting an offense or incident knowing it did not occur.
elements: (a): The suspect knowingly gave or caused to be given false information to law enforcement
OR (b): reported or caused to be reported an offense or incident knowing it did not occur, or pretended to furnish information about an offense knowing he had none
